scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @kiwi/server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w @kiwi/worker"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start -w @kiwi/server" "npm run start -w web -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p 4173" "npm run start -w @kiwi/worker"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kiwi/stash-box && npm run test -w @kiwi/scanner && npm run test -w @kiwi/downloads && npm run test -w @kiwi/media && npm run test -w @kiwi/worker && npm run test -w @kiwi/server && npm run test -w web && npm run build -w web
scripts.apple:build: cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project Kiwi.xcodeproj -scheme KiwiiOS -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData && xcodebuild build -project Kiwi.xcodeproj -scheme KiwiTV -destination 'platform=tvOS Simulator,name=Apple TV 4K (4th generation)' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData
scripts.apple:test: cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild test -project Kiwi.xcodeproj -scheme KiwiiOS -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -only-testing:KiwiiOSTests && xcodebuild test -project Kiwi.xcodeproj -scheme KiwiTV -destination 'platform=tvOS Simulator,name=Apple TV 4K (4th generation)' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -only-testing:KiwiTVTests
